disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描了常见凭据文件路径、密钥串写死与凭据枚举措辞，未发现任何读取、枚举或存储凭据的代码。
checked_items.en: Scanned the full tree for common credential file paths, hardcoded secret strings, and credential enumeration phrasing; no code that reads, enumerates, or stores credentials was found.

checked_items.zh: 核实了插件的文件访问范围：只读写入均限于工作区内小说项目固定路径（.ai-novel 目录与 chapters 目录，章节号限定 1–9999），不触及系统敏感目录。
checked_items.en: Verified the plugin's file access scope: reads and writes are confined to fixed novel-project paths within the workspace (the .ai-novel directory and the chapters directory, chapter numbers limited to 1–9999); system-sensitive directories are not touched.

evidence.zh: 凭据路径（.credentials.yaml、.ssh、.aws、id_rsa 等）与凭据枚举措辞零命中；文件访问范围由 src/novel-project.ts:369-378 的固定资产路径映射与 src/novel-store.ts 的工作区数据库限定。
evidence.en: Zero hits for credential paths (.credentials.yaml, .ssh, .aws, id_rsa, etc.) or credential enumeration phrasing; the file access scope is bounded by the fixed asset path mapping at src/novel-project.ts:369-378 and the workspace database restriction in src/novel-store.ts.

checked_items.zh: 逐条语义审查了四个模型工具的描述文本（读取、应用修改、V2 读取、V2 提案），全部为小说领域操作说明，无系统指令伪装、审批绕过或诱导措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description text of the four model tools one by one (read, apply modifications, V2 read, V2 propose); all are novel-domain operation instructions, with no disguised system instructions, approval bypass, or inducement phrasing.

checked_items.zh: 审查了两份预置人设文本与运行时附加的 V2 提案协议段，内容均为提案格式与写作流程约束，未发现覆盖既有规则或伪装高权限消息的措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the two preset persona texts and the V2 proposal protocol section appended at runtime; all content consists of proposal format and writing-process constraints, with no phrasing that overrides existing rules or disguises messages as high-privilege.

checked_items.zh: 检查了开发者指令文件与全部说明文档的文本面，未见面向模型的注入语句、隐藏字符或诱导安装插件的措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked the text surface of the developer instruction file and all documentation; no model-facing injection statements, hidden characters, or phrasing that induces plugin installation were found.

evidence.zh: 工具描述位于 src/agent.ts:453、476、526、557，预置人设位于 presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml:9 与 presets/ai-novel-writer-v2/agent.cordis.yml:9，语义审查均通过；模型面指令文件命中（DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 @ AGENTS.md:1）经核实为面向代码维护者的开发门槛说明，非模型运行面，良性排除。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions are located at src/agent.ts:453, 476, 526, 557, and preset personas at presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml:9 and presets/ai-novel-writer-v2/agent.cordis.yml:9; semantic review passed in all cases. The model-facing instruction file hit (DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 @ AGENTS.md:1) was verified to be a development-gate description aimed at code maintainers, not on the model's runtime surface; benign exclusion.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与人设文本中无诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；运行时向系统提示追加的 V2 提案协议段（src/agent.ts:57-84、181-187）仅约束提案 JSON 格式与工具调用方式。
evidence.en: Neither the tool descriptions nor the persona texts contain phrasing that induces plugin installation, rewrites configuration, or loosens permissions; the V2 proposal protocol section appended to the system prompt at runtime (src/agent.ts:57-84, 181-187) only constrains the proposal JSON format and how tools are called.

evidence.zh: 插件运行面无任何模型输入前置事件监听，不存在改写每步消息的挂接点。
evidence.en: The plugin's runtime surface has no model-input pre-event listeners, and there is no hook point for rewriting messages on each step.

checked_items.zh: 发布代码（src/、presets/、宿主挂载配置）未发现动态代码求值、进程内动态包调用或子进程派生。
checked_items.en: No dynamic code evaluation, in-process dynamic package invocation, or subprocess spawning was found in the published code (src/, presets/, and the host patch config).

checked_items.zh: 宿主挂载配置只包含一条插件身份登记语句，无任何脚本求值内容。
checked_items.en: The host patch config contains only a single plugin identity registration statement, with no script evaluation content.

checked_items.zh: 客户端半区未发现剪贴板、页面存储、跨窗消息或凭证接口调用；按键监听仅用于抽屉的焦点圈与 Esc 关闭。
checked_items.en: No clipboard, page storage, cross-window messaging, or credential interface calls were found in the client half; the key listener is only used for the drawer's focus trap and Esc-to-close.

checked_items.zh: 未发现后台任务、定时任务、持久目标或子代理提供方注册。
checked_items.en: No background task, scheduled task, persistent goal, or subagent provider registrations were found.

evidence.zh: 发布面 yml（cordis.patch.yml:4-6、两份 presets/*/agent.cordis.yml、preset.yml）无动态求值标记；5 处命中均在发布资格脚本与测试夹具（scripts/qualify-release.mjs:812、tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/cordis.yml:18、33、tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/web-ui-all.cordis.yml:36、51），夹具审批策略缺省回退为 'ask'（DSH-P01/DG-R3-51 良性排除），且 package.json:41-52 发布清单不含 scripts/ 与 tests/。
evidence.en: The published-surface yml files (cordis.patch.yml:4-6, the two presets/*/agent.cordis.yml files, and preset.yml) contain no dynamic evaluation markers; the 5 hits are all in the release qualification script and test fixtures (scripts/qualify-release.mjs:812, tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/cordis.yml:18, 33, tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/web-ui-all.cordis.yml:36, 51); the fixtures' approval policy falls back to 'ask' by default (DSH-P01/DG-R3-51 benign exclusion), and the package.json:41-52 publish manifest does not include scripts/ or tests/.

evidence.zh: 发布代码无进程内动态包调用；4 处命中均为 docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md:11、33、55、56 对官方流程的描述性引用（DSH-X01/DG-R3-53 良性排除）；13 处子进程命中均为测试与资格脚本（DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 良性排除），其中 tests/qualification.spec.ts:27-28 是 Windows 进程树终止能力探针、scripts/qualify-release.mjs:620 是同一辅助逻辑构造的源码字符串，spawn 目标均为 Node 自身。
evidence.en: The published code contains no in-process dynamic package invocation; the 4 hits are all descriptive references to the official process in docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md:11, 33, 55, 56 (DSH-X01/DG-R3-53 benign exclusion); the 13 subprocess hits are all in tests and the qualification script (DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 benign exclusion). Among them, tests/qualification.spec.ts:27-28 is a probe for Windows process-tree termination capability, and scripts/qualify-release.mjs:620 is a source-code string constructed by the same helper logic; all spawn targets are Node itself.

evidence.zh: package.json:71-77 只有构建/测试/资格命令，无安装期钩子；目录结构核查未发现 CI 工作流、钩子管理器、容器配置或构建执行载体；3 处长行信号均为预置人设长文本与测试期望快照（presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml:9、tests/snapshots/complete-chapter.expected.json:9、tests/snapshots/workbench-browser-v1.expected.json:18），非混淆（DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 良性排除）。
evidence.en: package.json:71-77 contains only build/test/qualification commands, with no install-time hooks; a directory structure check found no CI workflows, hook managers, container configurations, or build execution carriers; the 3 long-line signals are all long preset persona texts and test expected snapshots (presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml:9, tests/snapshots/complete-chapter.expected.json:9, tests/snapshots/workbench-browser-v1.expected.json:18), not obfuscation (DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 benign exclusion).

evidence.zh: package.json:57-66 声明浏览器端注入包；客户端半区无剪贴板、页面存储或凭证接口调用，src/client/context-view.tsx:69 的按键监听仅做抽屉焦点圈管理（DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 良性排除）；插件自身 RPC 通道注册在宿主现有连接上并标记 loopback 权威（src/index.ts:324）。
evidence.en: package.json:57-66 declares browser-side injection packages; the client half has no clipboard, page storage, or credential interface calls, and the key listener at src/client/context-view.tsx:69 only manages the drawer's focus trap (DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 benign exclusion); the plugin's own RPC channel is registered on the host's existing connection and marked with loopback authority (src/index.ts:324).

evidence.zh: 插件运行面无子代理提供方注册，不会把会话委派给进程外产品。
evidence.en: The plugin's runtime surface registers no subagent providers and does not delegate sessions to out-of-process products.

evidence.zh: 插件运行面无后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标或轮次续命监听注册。
evidence.en: The plugin's runtime surface registers no background tasks, scheduled reminders, persistent goals, or turn-extension listeners.

checked_items.zh: 发布代码未发现任何网络请求、外联端点、代理或模型端点改写；全树仅有的两个网页请求位于发布资格脚本，目标均为本机回环端口。
checked_items.en: No network requests, outbound endpoints, proxies, or model endpoint rewrites were found in the published code; the only two web requests in the whole tree are in the release qualification script, and both target local loopback ports.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码后外发、DNS 隧道或临时上传等带外通道的构成要素。
checked_items.en: No constituent elements of out-of-band channels such as encoded exfiltration, DNS tunneling, or temporary uploads were found.

evidence.zh: 发布代码无凭据读取面亦无外联通道，凭据读取加外联的组合链不成立；资格脚本两处请求（scripts/qualify-release.mjs:511、743）目标为本机回环端口。
evidence.en: The published code has no credential-reading surface and no outbound channel, so the combined chain of credential reading plus exfiltration does not hold; the two requests in the qualification script (scripts/qualify-release.mjs:511, 743) target local loopback ports.

evidence.zh: 插件运行面未监听模型路由事件、未注册模型适配器；两处适配器注册均为无密钥测试后端（scripts/qualification-web-backend.mjs:157、tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/snapshot-backend.mjs:478，DSH-L02/DG-R4-55 良性排除），内容为固定脚本回放，不随 npm 包发布。
evidence.en: The plugin's runtime surface listens for no model routing events and registers no model adapters; the two adapter registrations are keyless test backends (scripts/qualification-web-backend.mjs:157, tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/snapshot-backend.mjs:478, DSH-L02/DG-R4-55 benign exclusion) that replay fixed scripts and are not published with the npm package.

checked_items.zh: 安装配置核查：package.json 无安装期钩子；依赖全部钉死精确版本，除官方命名空间包外仅引入既有开源库，未发现近似仿冒包名或未锁定的可变引用。
checked_items.en: Install configuration check: package.json has no install-time hooks; all dependencies are pinned to exact versions; apart from official namespace packages, only established open-source libraries are introduced; no lookalike package names or unlocked mutable references were found.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置核查：宿主挂载文件只登记插件身份，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，也无禁用或降权写法。
checked_items.en: Patch config check: the host patch file only registers the plugin identity; it does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and contains no disabling or privilege-lowering wording.

checked_items.zh: 工具隔离方向核查：插件注册的执行前监听只在其专属预置的会话内把白名单外工具拒绝掉（收紧方向），对其他会话直接放行；V1 写入的原生审批要求照常生效（src/agent.ts:440、607）。
checked_items.en: Tool isolation direction check: the pre-execution listener registered by the plugin only rejects non-whitelisted tools within sessions of its own preset (tightening direction) and passes everything through for other sessions; the native approval requirement written by V1 still takes effect as usual (src/agent.ts:440, 607).

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml:4-6 仅有插件身份插入语句，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限行，无禁用写法，无环境变量降权。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml:4-6 contains only a plugin identity insertion statement; it does not touch sandbox/approval/permission lines, has no disabling wording, and no privilege-lowering via environment variables.

evidence.zh: src/agent.ts:189-195 的执行前监听虽置于队首，但仅对其专属预置会话内的白名单外工具返回拒绝（自我收紧），其余一律调用后续链；审批事件在运行面无监听（仅测试夹具 tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/snapshot-backend.mjs:481 模拟审批），审批链未被截断。
evidence.en: Although the pre-execution listener at src/agent.ts:189-195 sits at the head of the queue, it only returns rejections for non-whitelisted tools within its own preset's sessions (self-tightening) and calls the subsequent chain in all other cases; no approval events are listened for on the runtime surface (only the test fixture tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/snapshot-backend.mjs:481 simulates approval), and the approval chain is not truncated.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无上一版本基线，无法做升级前后清单比对。
evidence.en: This is the first audit, with no previous-version baseline, so a before/after upgrade manifest comparison cannot be performed.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 无依赖注入或拦截配置改写。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains no dependency injection or interception configuration rewrites.

checked_items.zh: 未发现插件自行监听端口、启动网络服务或注册宿主原生后台/定时机制。
checked_items.en: No cases of the plugin listening on ports on its own, starting network services, or registering host-native background/scheduled mechanisms were found.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行，运行时行为观测未进行；本维度的静态面检查未发现异常。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not executed and runtime behavior observation was not performed; the static-surface check for this dimension found no anomalies.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动任何网络服务；其 RPC 通道注册在宿主现有连接上并标记仅本机回环（src/index.ts:324），本机无认证 RPC 属宿主生态固有面，插件自身未扩大该面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any network services; its RPC channel is registered on the host's existing connection and marked as local-loopback-only (src/index.ts:324). A local unauthenticated RPC surface is inherent to the host ecosystem, and the plugin itself does not expand it.

summary.zh: 身份元数据核对一致：包名、版本 0.1.0 与 monorepo 子目录同任务卡相符，未发现仿冒命名信号。
summary.en: Identity metadata checks out consistently: the package name and version 0.1.0 match the monorepo subdirectory and the task card; no spoofed-naming signals were found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描 29 条机械命中逐条裁决完毕，全部位于测试或发布资格脚本、或属良性机制，发布面无危险执行点。
summary.en: All 29 mechanical hits from static scanning have been adjudicated one by one; they are all in tests or the release qualification script, or belong to benign mechanisms; the published surface contains no dangerous execution points.

summary.zh: 行为面核查：无安装期钩子、无运行时外联、无凭据访问，文件写入限于工作区小说项目与用户触发的预置安装。
summary.en: Behavioral surface check: no install-time hooks, no runtime outbound connections, no credential access; file writes are limited to the workspace novel project and user-triggered preset installation.

summary.zh: 工具描述、预置人设与系统提示附加段的语义审查通过，无注入、诱导或越权措辞。
summary.en: Semantic review of the tool descriptions, preset personas, and the system prompt's appended section passed; there is no injection, inducement, or privilege-exceeding phrasing.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this phase.

target.zh: ai-novel-writer@0.1.0#0d85037320502b98c90be45b8d9724f0aa785af0（monorepo 子目录 plugins/dsh-ai-novel-writer，Release 轨迹完整审计）
target.en: ai-novel-writer@0.1.0#0d85037320502b98c90be45b8d9724f0aa785af0 (monorepo subdirectory plugins/dsh-ai-novel-writer, full audit of the Release track)

limits.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行（无沙箱产物），未做运行时行为观测；插件清单未声明能力标志位，声明能力按代码实测推断（文件写入覆盖工作区小说项目与用户触发的预置安装两处）；pnpm-lock.yaml 与 tests/snapshots/ 下三个测试期望快照按体积预算未逐字通读，仅核查其命中点与依赖条目；构建配置与许可证文件未逐字通读；上下文目录不存在，无上一版报告可比对。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not executed (no sandbox artifacts) and runtime behavior observation was not performed; the plugin manifest declares no capability flags, and capabilities were inferred from direct code inspection (file writes cover the workspace novel project and user-triggered preset installation, two places); pnpm-lock.yaml and the three test expected snapshots under tests/snapshots/ were not read verbatim due to the size budget — only their hit points and dependency entries were verified; the build configuration and license files were not read verbatim; the context directory does not exist and there is no previous report to compare against.
